Introduction

Sullin is a Thai singer under MODHAUS. She is a member of the girl group tripleS and its sub-units Glow and Moon.

Sullin was introduced as the twenty-second member of the girl group tripleS on April 2, 2024. She debuted with tripleS on May 8, 2024, with the album "ASSEMBLE24".
